# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- The PSGPOTools Blazor project's goal is to provide a web-based Group Policy management console comparable to Microsoft MMC, with separate Computer and User sections and integration with Samba Active Directory.
- The PSGPOTools Web console should reproduce the official Group Policy Management Editor hierarchy for both Computer Configuration and User Configuration, including Policies, Software Settings, Windows Settings, Administrative Templates, and Preferences, with the same category ordering.
